notes: This narrow trace covers the IEEE 1516.1-2025 §11.3.1 rule for a joined federate subscribed to a FOM-added HLAreport subclass. The test sends one report subclass from a joined federate and checks exact class identity, all inherited standard parameters, and the subclass extension parameter. It does not cover the RTI-origin prohibition, parent-class promotion, or conformance.

requirements.statement: If joined federates subscribe to the subclass, they shall receive the full interaction.
